messages:
sam: Quick async standup — focus today: audits, IAM/KMS, vuln remediation. Post what you did / blockers / plan.

olivia: Done the IAM audit for svc-* roles yesterday. Found 2 roles with overly broad permissions (compute.admin). Filed PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/policies/pull/312 to tighten. Blocker: need approval from infra for rebind tests.

jamal: Picked up KMS key rotation tickets. Rotated dev keys and wrote a small playbook in /docs/kms-rotation.md. Blocker: staging uses old key alias, will coordinate with chris to update.

maria: Ran the nightly vuln scan (Snyk). Two medium findings in third-party lib; raised dependency PRs and pinned versions. No impact to prod. Will follow up with a minimal patch today.

chris: Happy to help with the staging KMS alias change. I can schedule a 30m window at 11:30 PT. pinging @olivia for permission to redeploy config.

sam: sec-bot, can you post latest image-scan summary?

sec-bot: Image scan completed 2026-03-24T07:10Z — 3 low, 1 medium (container: api-processor:sha256:... ). Medium relates to openssl CVE-2025-xxxx; mitigated by runtime flag. No active exploit seen.

olivia: Approving infra rebind tests now. @jamal, please rebase PR and add unit test for role scope check.

jamal: Will do. Also discovered an IAM policy attached to old-prod logging service — I removed it and logged in ./audits/logging-old-prod-2026-03-23.log

maria: For compliance checklist, I updated the control matrix (GRC-12) to mark KMS rotation steps as done for dev/staging. Prod pending.

sam: FYI I opened an issue to track cutover to customer-managed keys for dedicated tenants: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/892. Assigning to chris + infra PM.

chris: Acknowledged. I'll draft a proposal this afternoon.

olivia: Quick PR ping: @maria your dep bumps look good but can you add a changelog entry? small thing.

maria: On it.

sam: Any blockers preventing today's compliance doc handoff?

olivia: None from my side; waiting on prod KMS rotation confirmation.

jamal: I'll run a dry-run of rotation on staging at 11:30 PT with chris, then open a prod schedule request.

sam: Great. Thanks everyone. If anything urgent, call me or post here. :thumbsup:
